name: closeOutLoan
pre: A loan with the supplied loanid exists.
The selected loan has status LSOPEN.
post: Set the selected loan's status to CLOSED.
difficulty_basis: Existing-loan guard and one open-to-closed transition.
scenarios: LSOPEN loan becomes CLOSED and returns true.
effects_audit: No paid-off balance guard, loan deletion, payment cleanup or closing date invented.
